part.text: All 43 printf tests pass. Quick sanity check of the exact case from the issue:

Fixed. The bug was in `printf_arg_formatter::operator()` for `char_type` args (include/fmt/printf.h:1769), which unconditionally reset `align` to `align::right`, discarding the `align::left` set by the `-` flag parser (printf.h:1731). The fix preserves left alignment when it was already set:

```cpp
if (fmt_specs.align != align::left) fmt_specs.align = align::right;
```
